_doc: Priors for the free parameters (PLAN §7.1). Uniform or log-uniform on [lo, hi]. Names are dotted paths into Params (packages/sim/src/types.ts). Everything else stays at packages/sim/src/params/defaults.json.

parameters.name: host.complianceBase
parameters.note: share of single-listing investors who comply at once

parameters.name: host.anticipation
parameters.note: monthly exit hazard of law-abiding hosts between announcement and Phase 1 (also weights the anticipated penalty for others)

parameters.name: host.prShare
parameters.note: principal-residence share of 2023 listings (unobserved); must be < 1 - 0.4605

parameters.name: host.investorEntry
parameters.note: investor purchases in zones without the rule (spillover)

parameters.name: str.demandSpillover
parameters.note: displaced tourist demand moving to exempt zones

parameters.name: rental.arrivalRentElasticity
parameters.note: renter arrivals vs asking rents; not identified by listing moments, kept to carry rent-effect uncertainty
